name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when remodeling a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when remodeling a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid over-improving the property beyond what local market rents can support, as this reduces your return on investment. Underestimating the budget or timeline are common issues, so always factor in a contingency. Another pitfall is neglecting necessary permits, which can lead to fines and rework. Finally, choosing overly trendy or high-maintenance materials can make the property less appealing to a wider tenant base and increase future repair costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid over-improving, underestimating budget/timeline, neglecting permits, and choosing high-maintenance materials that deter tenants or increase future costs.
